title: 第2章 豪门千金（2）-《反派BOSS有毒》
content:
第(1/3)页

    装修奢华的大厅中，放着舒缓的音乐，精心打扮过的俊男靓女三两成群的站在一起交谈。

    时笙坐在角落，表情自然镇定，没有一点的不适。

    这场宴会是南宫夫人的生辰宴会，也正是原主将苏衣衣告到南宫景父母前的那天。

    原主的遗愿是远离渣男，保护好许家，孝敬许氏父母，让他们安享晚年。

    “乘月，你怎么坐在这里？景少怎么没和你一起？”一道靓丽的人影坐到时笙旁边，来人一头齐腰卷发，一张娃娃脸很是可爱。

    时笙在脑中提出来人的资料。

    蓝雪，和原主关系较好的朋友，当然，只是原主单方面的以为。

    当初许家落败，许乘月去请蓝雪帮忙，蓝雪不但不帮忙，反而冷嘲热讽的刺激了许乘月一番。

    原主知道南宫景和苏衣衣打得火热，也是从她口中知道的。

    “不知道。”时笙面无表情的回答。

    远离心机婊！

    远离白莲花！

    蓝雪有些狐疑，但是也没多想，只当她是心情不好。毕竟任谁看到自家未婚夫和别的女人搂搂抱抱，没人受不了。

    “乘月，刚才我看到苏衣衣了。”蓝雪语气中满是担忧，可面上却没一丝担忧的神色，“景少是你的未婚夫，你可不能让那个女人占了风头。”

    因为南宫景的父亲还没有退下来，所以这个圈子一直叫南宫景景少。

    时笙余光扫了她一眼，蓝雪很多时候都没有多加掩饰，原主到底是有多瞎才没有看出蓝雪对自己并没有那么友好？

    小说中女配智商永远不在线上这句话说得一点没错。

    “她怎么进来的？”时笙也不想现在和蓝雪撕破脸，就随口问了一句。

    她当然知道女主是怎么进来的，每一本小说中，除了男主，还有许多高大上情深不悔的男配。

    苏衣衣就是跟着一号男配，凌浩过来的。

    “和凌家小少爷一起过来的，那女人勾引景少还勾引凌少，也不知道哪儿学的这些狐媚手段，太不要脸了。”蓝雪一脸的愤然。

    时笙正想说话，旁边忽然响起一道磁性的嗓音，仔细听的话能从里面听出一丝不耐。
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

In the luxuriously decorated hall, soothing music is playing, and handsome men and women who have been carefully dressed stand together in groups and talk.

Shi Sheng was sitting in the corner, his expression naturally calm, without any discomfort.

This banquet was Mrs. Nangong’s birthday banquet, and it was also the day when the original owner sued Su Yiyi to Nangong Jing’s parents.

The original owner’s last wish was to stay away from the scumbag, protect the Xu family, honor Xu’s parents, and let them enjoy their old age.

"Chengyue, why are you sitting here? Why aren't Mr. Jing with you?" A beautiful figure sat next to Shi Sheng. The figure had waist-length curly hair and a very cute baby face.

Shi Sheng brought up the person's information in his mind.

​​Lan Xue, a friend who has a good relationship with the original owner, of course, is just the original owner’s unilateral opinion.

When the Xu family was defeated, Xu Chengyue went to ask Lan Xue for help. Lan Xue not only refused to help, but instead irritated Xu Chengyue with sarcasm.

The original owner knew that Nangong Jing and Su Yiyi had a fierce fight, and he also knew it from her mouth.

"I don't know." Shi Sheng replied expressionlessly.

Stay away from the scheming bitch!

Stay away from White Lotus!

Lan Xue was a little suspicious, but she didn't think much about it and just thought she was in a bad mood.After all, no one can bear to see their fiancé cuddling with another woman.

"Chengyue, I saw Su Yiyi just now." Lan Xue's tone was full of worry, but there was no trace of worry on her face, "Young Master Jing is your fiancé, you can't let that woman take the spotlight."

Because Nangong Jing’s father has not retired yet, this circle has always called him Nangong Jingjing.

Shi Sheng glanced at her out of the corner of his eye. Lan Xue didn't hide it much at all. How blind was the original owner to not see that Lan Xue was not that friendly to him?

It is absolutely correct to say that the IQ of female protagonists in novels is never above the line.

"How did she get in?" Shi Sheng didn't want to break up with Lan Xue now, so she asked casually.

Of course she knows how the heroine came in. In every novel, in addition to the hero, there are many high-ranking male partners who are deeply in love and have no regrets.

Su Yiyi came here with the number one supporting actor, Ling Hao.

"I came here with the young master of the Ling family. That woman seduced Young Master Jing and also seduced Young Master Ling. I don't know where she learned these charming tricks. It's so shameless." Lan Xue looked angrily.

Shi Sheng was about to speak when a magnetic voice suddenly sounded next to him. If you listened carefully, you could hear a hint of impatience in it.
